source.formationChecks: 64 paired seeds × both sides per column flip

skill.name: Haze
skill.desc: Icy haze over its target and those nearby: removes their shields and buffs, and shields itself.

skill.name: Light Screen
skill.desc: Zones out for a second, then raises a light screen: a shield for itself and a slightly smaller one for each adjacent ally.

skill.name: Rock Blast
skill.desc: Throws 3 rocks at its target and hides in its shell: a shield that grows with its Defense.

skill.name: Hypnosis
skill.desc: Hypnotizes its target and puts it to sleep for 2s; its next attack is a Wake-Up Slap: double damage to the sleeper, and it wakes it up.

skill.name: Water Pulse
skill.desc: Water rings at the enemy with the most Energy: drains it, blocks it from charging for a while and confuses it for 1s.

skill.name: Lovely Kiss
skill.desc: Blows a kiss at its target and puts it to sleep.

skill.name: Teleport
skill.desc: Teleports away from whoever is hitting it while keeping its target in range (if there is no room, it stays) and its next 3 attacks carry a psychic strike; the 3rd lowers the target’s Sp. Def by 25% for 4s.

skill.name: Light Screen
skill.desc: Zones out for a second, then raises a light screen: a shield for itself and a slightly smaller one for each adjacent ally.

skill.name: Egg Bomb
skill.desc: Throws 3 exploding eggs at the tightest enemy clusters.

skill.name: Wild Charge
skill.desc: Electrifies itself: its next 5 attacks (7 at 3★) hit harder and jump to 2 nearby enemies, and it attacks faster for 4s. The last one paralyzes.

skill.name: Growth
skill.desc: The mushroom grows: each time it uses this it gains 12% Attack until the end of combat, and 5% lifesteal on its first 3 uses. Every 3 uses it releases spores that put adjacent enemies to sleep for 1.5s.

skill.name: Hyper Beam
skill.desc: A beam that crosses the whole board. Afterwards it must recharge for a moment.

skill.name: Light Screen
skill.desc: Zones out for a second, then raises a light screen: a shield for itself and a slightly smaller one for each adjacent ally.
